ideas.title: The impact of fraud on Minnesota's child care system
ideas.description: Investigate the impact of fraud on Minnesota's child care system and how it affects the state's most vulnerable populations.
ideas.angle: The human impact of fraud on child care funding
questions: How much funding has been lost to fraud?
What are the consequences for child care providers and recipients?
searches: impact of fraud on child care
ideas.insight: This story could shed light on a critical issue affecting Minnesota's most vulnerable populations and hold those responsible for fraud accountable.

ideas.title: The mastermind behind Minnesota's biggest fraud scheme
ideas.description: Investigate Aimee Bock's role in Minnesota's biggest fraud scheme and the extent of her involvement.
ideas.angle: The rise and fall of Aimee Bock
questions: What was Aimee Bock's role in the scheme?
How did she manage to carry out the fraud?
ideas.insight: This story could provide a detailed look at the inner workings of a large-scale fraud scheme and the individuals involved.
